auth.name: Full name
auth.passwordRule: At least {passwordMin} characters. A phrase you remember is safer than a complicated word.

login.title: Sign in
login.lockHint: After {maxAttempts} wrong attempts sign-in is locked for {lockMinutes} minutes.

invite.title: Activate your account
invite.intro: You have been invited to {azienda} with the role {role}. Check the name your colleagues will see and choose a password.

forgot.title: Forgotten password
forgot.intro: Enter your email: if it belongs to an active account, you will receive a link to choose a new one.
forgot.sent: If the email belongs to an active account, the link is on its way. Check your spam folder too.
forgot.noMail: Email sending is not enabled on this portal. Ask an administrator for a password link.

linkInvalid.title: Invalid link
linkInvalid.invite: This invite has expired, has already been used or was revoked. Ask whoever sent it for a new one.
linkInvalid.reset: This link has expired or has already been used. Ask for a new one.

error.locked: Too many wrong attempts. Try again in {lockMinutes} minutes.
error.deactivated: This account is deactivated. Contact an administrator.
error.name: Enter a name of at least 2 characters.
error.confirm: The two passwords do not match.
error.userExists: An account with this email already exists. Sign in or ask for a password link.

problem.tooShort: The password must be at least {passwordMin} characters.
problem.tooLong: The password can be at most {passwordMax} characters.
problem.common: This password is among the most used: choose a less predictable one.
problem.personal: The password must not contain your name or email.
problem.repetitive: The password repeats the same characters too much.

account.title: Your account
account.mustChange: This is a temporary password: you must choose a new one before using the portal.
account.prefsText: Language (Italiano, Български, English) and theme (automatic, light, dark) are at the bottom of every page and are saved to your account.

error.same: The new password must differ from the current one.
